verdict.rationale: Gunderson Dettmer is a law firm whose core product is legal counsel, so self-hosting the core product is a category error for this kind of offering. Its client-facing tools (GDHQ, Contract Generator, D&O Portal, Catalyze) are firm-hosted platforms, and nothing in the evidence shows any self-hostable deployment that would make the axis applicable.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
